flash_notes: Erase existing RepRapFirmware first: fit the Erase jumper, power on, remove jumper, reboot. Then flash Klipper via USB (bossac).

DRIVE_0.label: Drive 0 (typically X)
DRIVE_0.notes: Onboard TMC2660 (SPI on usart1). Enable pin is shared by all drives.

DRIVE_1.label: Drive 1 (typically Y)
DRIVE_1.notes: Onboard TMC2660 (SPI on usart1). Enable pin is shared by all drives.

DRIVE_2.label: Drive 2 (typically Z)
DRIVE_2.notes: Onboard TMC2660 (SPI on usart1). Enable pin is shared by all drives.

DRIVE_3.label: Drive 3 (typically E0)
DRIVE_3.notes: Onboard TMC2660 (SPI on usart1). Enable pin is shared by all drives.

DRIVE_4.label: Drive 4 (typically E1)
DRIVE_4.notes: Onboard TMC2660 (SPI on usart1). Enable pin is shared by all drives.

E1_OUT.label: E1 Heater
E1_OUT.notes: Active-low output (pin is inverted). Usable as a spare output if E1 is unused.

E0_STOP.label: E0 Endstop
E0_STOP.notes: Usable as a spare input (e.g. filament sensor)

E1_STOP.label: E1 Endstop
E1_STOP.notes: Usable as a spare input (e.g. filament sensor)

notes: Onboard TMC2660 drivers - select TMC2660 as driver type for every stepper (sense resistor 0.051)
All drives share one enable pin (!PC6); ignore duplicate-pin warnings for it
Heater outputs are active-low - keep the '!' prefix on heater pins
Z-probe and expansion header pins are not listed; enter them as raw pins if needed
